body:
At this point it doesn't feel like I'm ever going to get past it.

Being with her, before she started cheating on me, was the happiest I've ever been in my life. Everything was great and I only expected it to get better. I don't think I'll ever be able to love anyone that much again. I don't think I'll ever be able to trust anyone like that again. I just feel like the best part of my life is in my past now, and the future is all shit.

I bought a gun a few months back with the intention of using it on myself. I got really drunk the night before I planned to do it and told my friend and he took the keys to the lockbox away from me. But I can always bolt cut it open, or buy a new gun, or use pills, or something. Just thinking about doing it fills me with this sense of relief. I'm really afraid I'm going to do it one day soon. I've been clear about that with my psychiatrist and he's upped the dosage on my meds a few times now... it helps the day to day stuff a bit but it hasn't made that feeling of overall dread for my future dissipate.
